premises.text: 3D printing is revolutionizing various industries and is a billion-dollar market expected to grow significantly.
premises.evidence_span: 3D printing is a billion-dollar market now and is expected to triple in five years.

premises.text: 3DLT provides a marketplace for designers to sell 3D printable files.
premises.evidence_span: creating a marketplace where designers can sell professional-level 3D printable files.

premises.text: Consumers can purchase and download designs to print at home or through local print shops.
premises.evidence_span: you can purchase, download, and manufacture right from the comfort of your home.

premises.text: 3DLT allows customization of products based on individual consumer specifications.
premises.evidence_span: To customize, you'll just enter in your size and width, and voila, custom stilettos fitted perfectly for you.

premises.text: The business model generates revenue from design sales and profits from printing.
premises.evidence_span: we generate revenue from the design and profit from the sale of print.

premises.text: 3DLT enables competition among 3D printers, leading to lower prices for consumers.
premises.evidence_span: With competition comes commoditization, and that means lower pricing for you.

premises.text: There will be a growing demand for 3D printable content as the market evolves.
premises.evidence_span: Soon, there will be an insatiable, worldwide demand for 3D printable content.

premises.text: The model of 3D printing will shift from prototyping to finished products in the near future.
premises.evidence_span: by 2020, the model will flip. And 80%, or over 4 billion, will be consumed as finished product.

value.text: Consumers gain access to a wide variety of customizable 3D printed products.
value.evidence_span: you can work directly with our designers to fast-track the innovation to new products.

notes: No external knowledge applied; all claims are based on the transcript.
